Our commercial and industrial solar solutions are designed to make it easier for you to take advantage of solar energy’s immense potential, cut expenses, and improve sustainability. **Steps to Take After Selecting Us**

01

**Select the Right Type of Solar Panel**

After selecting us, it is crucial to choose the best type of solar panel for your needs in terms of both energy production and budget. Our Solar Company Malaysia team will guide you through the available options while considering efficiency, durability, and aesthetics.

![Lifecycle1](https://pensolar.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Lifecycle1.png)

02

**Site Survey with Our Engineer**

A site survey with our qualified engineer is essential to determine the best placement and configuration of your solar panels. In order to maximise the output and efficiency of your Solar System Malaysia, this assessment considers a number of factors, including shading, roof condition, and orientation.

![Lifecycle2](https://pensolar.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Lifecycle2.png)

03

**Right Permit for Your Installation**

Complying with local laws and maintaining a smooth procedure require obtaining the permits and approvals for your Solar Panel Installation Malaysia. In order to save you time and effort, our experts will handle the permit application process, making sure that all requirements are met.

![Lifecycle3](https://pensolar.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Lifecycle3.png)

04

**Let Us Handle All the Arrangements**

Once all the required permits are obtained, it’s time to let our solar contractor handle all things. We will schedule everything, order the equipment, communicate with subcontractors if necessary, and make all other arrangements. Knowing that your project is in good hands, sit back and relax.

![Lifecycle4](https://pensolar.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Lifecycle4.png)

05

**Connect Solar System to Power Supply**

Connecting your solar system to the inverter and the power supply is the last installation step. Doing this ensures that your solar panels can effectively turn sunlight into useful electricity. In accordance with safety guidelines and industry best practices, our experts will carefully make this connection.

![Depositphotos 235594976 L](https://pensolar.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/Depositphotos_235594976_L-1333x1333.jpg)

**Benefits and Drawbacks  of Solar**

| Benefits of Solar | Drawbacks of Solar |
| --- | --- |
| Renewable energy source. | High initial costs. |
| Cost savings on electricity bills. | Dependence on sunlight and weather conditions. |
| Environmental friendliness with no greenhouse gas emissions. | Limited efficiency compared to other energy sources. |
| Energy independence and reduced reliance on the grid. | Space requirements for installation. |
| Government incentives and tax credits. | Challenges in energy storage. |

**Go Solar With Pensolar!**

## Reduce Energy Costs

By harnessing the power of the sun and converting it into electricity, you can significantly reduce your energy bills. Our state-of-the-art Solar System Malaysia allows you to take control of your energy consumption and enjoy long-term savings.

## Empower Yourself as a Prosumer

By adopting our Solar Company Malaysia cutting-edge solar systems, you can become a prosumer—generating your own electricity and even selling the excess energy back to us. Embrace self-sufficiency and contribute to the energy ecosystem while earning incentives.

## Reliable and Comprehensive Solutions

With years of experience serving customers in Malaysia, Pensolar offers worry-free solar solutions. From initial design to seamless installation and ongoing maintenance, our dedicated team of Solar Installer Malaysia will guide you every step of the way. We ensure a hassle-free experience so you can enjoy the benefits of solar energy without any concerns.

## A Greener Environment

Solar energy is a clean and sustainable alternative to traditional energy sources. Going solar with our Solar Panel Installer allows you to actively contribute to a better environment. Solar power is green, emitting no pollutants during production or consumption and helping to reduce carbon emissions. By choosing solar, you play a vital role in mitigating the impact of climate change.

Frequently Asked Questions

#### [How much does installing a solar PV system cost?](https://pensolar.com.my/\#faq01003f-b389)

The price will vary depending on your needs. To optimize your savings, our Solar PV Engineers will design a solar PV system that is appropriate for your electricity demand, your available roof space, and your budget.

#### [How often should solar panels be cleaned and maintained?](https://pensolar.com.my/\#faq02003f-b389)

Solar power systems require extremely minimal maintenance because they are hardwired and free of moving parts. But the amount of time required for cleaning and maintenance can vary and relies on several factors, like the slope of your roof, where your building is located, whether there are any particles present, etc.

#### [Does our Malaysian government offer any tax benefits to my company?](https://pensolar.com.my/\#faq03003f-b389)

Yes, when you switch to renewable energy sources like solar power, you can benefit from the Green Investment Tax Allowance (GITA) from MIDA and the Capital Allowance (CA) from LHDN.
